in_sanskrit.name: Ansith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Answer, truth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ansith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit ‘ans’ (answer) and ‘sith’ (truth). This name signifies the seeker of truth and the answerer of questions. In Hindu mythology, Ansith is the name of a sage who imparted knowledge to the divine sage Vyasa, helping him compose the great epic Mahabharata.
